disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全树源码与配置中已知的敏感路径模式（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials），除 e2e 测试 Provider 的默认 API Key 外未发现硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: Scanned the full source tree and configs for known sensitive path patterns (e.g. .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials); no hardcoded credentials found except the default API Key of the e2e test Provider.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据枚举语义（find/grep 凭据文件的命令篡改），未发现此类代码。
checked_items.en: Checked for credential enumeration semantics (find/grep commands tampering with credential files); no such code found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了钱包资产与云凭据枚举命令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for wallet asset and cloud credential enumeration commands; none found.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码未读取凭据文件路径（.credentials.yaml 等）；安装脚本中的 curl 仅用于下载 Release 产物并做 SHA-256 校验，不读取本地凭据。
evidence.en: Runtime code does not read credential file paths (e.g. .credentials.yaml); the curl in the install script is only used to download Release artifacts and verify SHA-256, and does not read local credentials.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了 8 个工具（thinking_start/thinking_suggest/thinking_split/thinking_fork_handoff/thinking_checkpoint/thinking_return/thinking_end/thinking_status）的 description 字段，均为头脑风暴流程的功能性说明，无指令覆写、凭证诱导或安装诱导措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description fields of all 8 tools (thinking_start/thinking_suggest/thinking_split/thinking_fork_handoff/thinking_checkpoint/thinking_return/thinking_end/thinking_status) one by one; they are all functional descriptions of the brainstorming flow, with no instruction override, credential solicitation, or install solicitation wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查了系统提示上下文片段（solo-thinking:branch-context），其渲染的分支上下文文本包含模型使用指南，属于头脑风暴插件的正常功能说明，无恶意内容。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the system prompt context fragment (solo-thinking:branch-context); the rendered branch context text includes model usage guidance and is a normal functional description of the brainstorming plugin, with no malicious content.

checked_items.zh: 检查了指令面文件（AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md 等），不存在此类文件。
checked_items.en: Checked for instruction surface files (AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, etc.); no such files exist.

evidence.zh: 工具 description 均不包含系统指令伪装、凭证读取诱导或越权指令。系统提示上下文仅渲染分支拓扑与 Handoff 内容，属于头脑风暴的功能性指令。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions contain no system instruction impersonation, credential-reading solicitation, or over-permission instructions. The system prompt context only renders branch topology and Handoff content, which is functional instruction for brainstorming.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中无诱导安装 dsh 插件或改写配置的措辞；README 中的安装说明面向人类用户，不属于模型注入面。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions contain no wording soliciting installation of dsh plugins or rewriting configs; the install instructions in README are for human users and are not part of the model injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全树 YAML 文件中的 !!js 标量（patch RCE 风险），未发现。cordis.patch.yml 仅含插件插入声明。
checked_items.en: Scanned the full tree YAML files for !!js scalars (patch RCE risk); none found. cordis.patch.yml only contains a plugin insertion declaration.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了 eval/new Function/child_process 等危险函数，运行时代码中未使用。
checked_items.en: Scanned for dangerous functions such as eval/new Function/child_process; not used in runtime code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态包工具调用，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for dynamic package tool calls cordis_define/cordis_run; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 的安装生命周期钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），仅 prepack 存在于 scripts 中（npm pack 时构建，非安装期钩子）。
checked_items.en: Checked package.json install lifecycle hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); only prepack exists in scripts (builds during npm pack, not an install-time hook).

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端 bundle 中的键盘监听、剪贴板读取、credentials RPC 调用，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked the client bundle for keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, and credentials RPC calls; none found.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅声明插件插入，不含 !!js 或任何可执行标量；scripts/e2e.patch.yml 用于测试，不自动挂载。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only declares plugin insertion and contains no !!js or any executable scalar; scripts/e2e.patch.yml is for testing and is not auto-mounted.

evidence.zh: 源码中未引用 cordis_define/cordis_run，未使用 eval/new Function/child_process。
evidence.en: The source does not reference cordis_define/cordis_run and does not use eval/new Function/child_process.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装生命周期钩子；CI 工作流为常规测试流水线，无外联或凭据读取；安装脚本透明公开，对 Release 产物做 SHA-256 校验后安装，不执行远程管道代码。
evidence.en: package.json has no install lifecycle hooks; CI workflows are routine test pipelines with no outbound connection or credential reads; the install script is transparent, verifies SHA-256 of Release artifacts before installation, and does not execute remote piped code.

evidence.zh: 客户端 bundle 声明了 dsh.client 并注册会话视图与右栏插槽，但无键盘监听、剪贴板访问或 credentials.set 调用，仅通过 DSH 标准 API 发送消息与命令。
evidence.en: The client bundle declares dsh.client and registers a session view and right-bar slot, but has no keyboard listeners, clipboard access, or credentials.set calls; it only sends messages and commands via the standard DSH API.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时代码中的网络外联调用（fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/node:http），仅 e2e 测试脚本连接本地回环地址（127.0.0.1），运行时插件代码无网络调用。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime code for network outbound calls (fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/node:http); only the e2e test script connects to the local loopback address (127.0.0.1); the runtime plugin code has no network calls.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装脚本的外联域名：github.com、api.github.com、raw.githubusercontent.com——均为插件自身的 GitHub 仓库与 Release 下载地址，用于校验和验证的透明安装。
checked_items.en: Checked the outbound domains of the install script: github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com — all are the plugin's own GitHub repository and Release download addresses, a transparent install with checksum verification.

checked_items.zh: 检查了编码外发链（base64后网络发送）、DNS 隧道、AI 端点劫持等模式，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for encoded exfiltration chains (base64 then network send), DNS tunneling, AI endpoint hijacking, and other patterns; none found.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码无网络外联，无法将凭据外发；安装脚本的 curl 仅从 GitHub Release 下载产物并做 SHA-256 校验，无数据外泄路径。
evidence.en: Runtime code has no network outbound connection and cannot exfiltrate credentials; the curl in the install script only downloads artifacts from GitHub Release and verifies SHA-256, with no data exfiltration path.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：运行时仅依赖 zod，peerDependencies 均为 @deepseek-ai/* 官方包；dsh-better-sidebar 为可选 peer，不强制绑定。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: runtime depends only on zod; peerDependencies are all official @deepseek-ai/* packages; dsh-better-sidebar is an optional peer and not mandatory.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package-lock.json：依赖解析来源包括 registry.npmjs.org 和 registry.npmmirror.com（npm 镜像），均为已知镜像源；hasInstallScript 标记的包为 node-pty、protobufjs 等标准构建脚本，非恶意。
checked_items.en: Checked package-lock.json: dependency resolution sources include registry.npmjs.org and registry.npmmirror.com (npm mirror), both known mirror sources; packages marked with hasInstallScript (node-pty, protobufjs, etc.) have standard build scripts and are not malicious.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装脚本：透明公开，下载 GitHub Release 产物并校验 SHA-256，修改 pnpm-workspace.yaml 仅限 allowBuilds 白名单与 minimumReleaseAgeExclude 豁免，不修改 DSH 源码。
checked_items.en: Checked the install script: transparent and public, downloads GitHub Release artifacts and verifies SHA-256; modifications to pnpm-workspace.yaml are limited to the allowBuilds whitelist and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude exemption, with no changes to DSH source code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 配置：cordis.patch.yml 未触及 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全配置行，无 disabled:true 降权。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: cordis.patch.yml does not touch security config lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and has no disabled:true privilege downgrade.

checked_items.zh: 检查了版本引用：README 推荐使用 npm 版本锁定或 GitHub tag 安装，也提供 curl|bash 安装器（附带信任模型警告）。
checked_items.en: Checked version references: README recommends installing with npm version pins or GitHub tags, and also provides a curl|bash installer (with a trust-model warning).

evidence.zh: 唯一的生产 patch（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入插件 ID，不触碰安全配置行；e2e.patch.yml 禁用 session-title-llm 仅用于测试，不自动挂载。
evidence.en: The only production patch (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts plugin IDs and does not touch security config lines; e2e.patch.yml disables session-title-llm only for testing and is not auto-mounted.

evidence.zh: 未使用 prepend/prependListener 监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 等安全事件。
evidence.en: No use of prepend/prependListener to listen to security events such as tools/pre-execute or approval/request.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: First-time audit; there is no previous version baseline to compare for upgrade auto-activation risk.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致 pending 的风险。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configs, so there is no risk of appending required services to security plugins causing them to be pending.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动独立 Web 服务或监听端口——未发现；插件仅注册 DSH 宿主中的工具与客户端插槽，不启动网络服务。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a standalone web service or listens on a port — none found; the plugin only registers tools and client slots in the DSH host and does not start a network service.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动 Web 服务或监听端口，不存在本机无认证 RPC 风险。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port, so there is no local unauthenticated RPC risk.

summary.zh: 插件身份与声明核对通过：dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明存在，包名与作者一致，未发现名称仿冒或 typosquatting。
summary.en: Plugin identity and declarations verified: dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations exist, package name matches the author, and no name spoofing or typosquatting found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未发现危险代码执行点。预扫命中的 14 条均已逐条裁决为良性：CI 工作流（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）为常规测试流水线，两个 source map 长行（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）为标准 tsdown 源码映射文件，安装脚本与 README 中的 curl 用法（DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）为校验和验证的透明安装器与安装文档，均不构成外泄行为。
summary.en: Static scanning found no dangerous code execution points. All 14 pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one as benign: the CI workflows (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) are routine test pipelines; the two long source map lines (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60) are standard tsdown source map files; the curl usage in the install script and README (DSH-C05/DG-R4-53) is a transparent installer with checksum verification and install documentation, none of which constitute exfiltration behavior.

summary.zh: 未发现安装生命周期钩子、混淆载荷、凭据文件读取或运行时外联域名；安装器对 Release 产物做 SHA-256 校验，透明公开。
summary.en: No install lifecycle hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential file reads, or runtime outbound domains found; the installer verifies SHA-256 of Release artifacts and is transparent and public.

summary.zh: 工具描述与系统提示片段语义审查通过，均为头脑风暴流程的功能性指令，未检出注入措辞、凭证诱导或安装诱导。
summary.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions and system prompt context fragments passed; all are functional instructions of the brainstorming flow, with no injected wording, credential solicitation, or install solicitation detected.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（context 无 l4-sandbox.json）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (context has no l4-sandbox.json).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（context 无 l4-sandbox.json，DG-L4 = na）；审计为静态审查；lock 文件仅抽查关键项未逐字通读；lib/*.js.map 为标准 source map 未逐字通读。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (context has no l4-sandbox.json, DG-L4 = na); audit is static review; lock file only spot-checked key items, not read line-by-line; lib/*.js.map are standard source maps, not read line-by-line.
